purpose: Reusable official membership certificate template for all approved RLS Association members.
source: User-supplied reference image from 2026-11-10. Preserve its layout, ornaments, colors, Russian landmarks, flag, upper-left journal emblem, and lower-center seal placement.

fixed_visuals.border: ornate double navy-and-gold academic frame with decorative corners
fixed_visuals.upper_left: journal seal-derived emblem adapted for association certificate
fixed_visuals.left: Saint Basil's Cathedral illustration and laurel
fixed_visuals.lower_center: fixed journal seal extracted from the supplied Word document

data_rules.membership_start_date_source: same effective date used by the member profile: reviewed_at when approved; otherwise created_at fallback
data_rules.member_number_assignment: Allocate only when membership_status changes to approved, by a database-controlled global sequence; immutable after assignment; unique; never reused
data_rules.member_number_format: six-digit global serial; Persian numerals on Persian certificates (000001, 000002, ...)
data_rules.issue_date_source: current Asia/Tehran date at the moment the certificate is generated
data_rules.authenticity_method: QR opens the member profile. The profile displays member number, approved membership status, membership group, and the same membership date. No separate validation code or lookup page is printed.
data_rules.numbers: Render Persian numerals in Persian copy; the QR contains only the direct profile URL.
data_rules.member_number_pending: Pending and rejected applications have no official membership number

print_notes: Use actual member data only; never invent dates or serial numbers.
The certificate membership date must equal the membership date shown on the member profile; use the same stored date and Asia/Tehran calendar conversion.
Do not print a separate validation code.
The QR code must resolve directly to the member profile, not to a standalone verification page.
The profile reached through QR must visibly show the member number and approved status; unavailable, private, suspended, or unapproved profiles cannot confirm membership.
Member numbers are six-digit global serials assigned only upon approval, then immutable and never recycled. Gaps are acceptable; duplicates are not.
Do not alter the master border, palette, layout, logo, or seal position for individual members.
Keep the QR code readable with a white quiet zone.
Use A4 landscape and print-color-adjust: exact.
